reviews.text: Hobert is the best example of a pool builder company! From our first appointment with our sales consultant Chris we felt confident with his expertise and design skills. Our project manager Tony was excellent; from the front desk, scheduling, to every single worker or team that showed up all were top notch. Group texts and emails kept us in the loop. It was like a choreographed dance that turned our dream into an outside oasis. I feel like they lost money on us! We are even using their pool cleaning service now.
reviews.author: Michele Sautarel

reviews.text: This is the 3rd pool I have had built and overall the best experience.  I had a small space which presented some challenges, but Chris came up with a beautiful design which utilized the available space effectively. The project also included an overlay which was applied to the existing patio.  The overlay turned out beautifully and flows well with the pavers around the pool. The communications during the process were excellent and timely.  We had a challenge to overcome at the end of the project, but Hobert resolved the issue.  I would recommend Hobert and would use them again.
reviews.author: Terri Acton

reviews.text:
There’s a reason Hobert Pools has been around since 1975 — their quality of work, professional staff, and attention to detail at every step of the process are unmatched. I cannot speak highly enough about the finished product and how thrilled we are with it.

Our salesperson, Ryan Rees, guided us from the very beginning toward our dream pool. He stayed in constant communication, never pressured us, and patiently reviewed multiple designs until we found exactly what we wanted.

Their project managers were equally outstanding — always responsive, thorough, and professional. A special thank-you to Tony for his patience and support throughout the entire project. You answered every question and gave us peace of mind from start to finish.

If you’re looking for a company that delivers top-notch quality and the pool of your dreams, look no further than Hobert Pools.

Thank you!
Shawn & Denarie Garris
reviews.author: denarie garris

reviews.text: Dean, Tony, Angela, and the entire Hobert team were absolutely awesome!!  They stayed in touch every step of the way, did exactly what they said they would do, and sometimes even earlier than expected.  From the moment the permit was approved the pool was complete in less than 2 months.  And it came out spectacular.  I would 1,000,000% recommend Hobert.  Pool came out stunning!
reviews.author: Alex Vidal

reviews.text:
Update as of 7/15/25

Hobert contacted me after seeing the review and contacted me. They offered to come out and revisit the pool deck. They did in a timely manner, offered to refinish the entire patio with a coating. I really am happy with the final results. Much better and I am thankful they took the time to take care of this. I am updating the star review as well.

Bad experience overall. There are a lot of builders out there and I’m sure all will have some sort of issue at some point. Biggest issue is I not only have cracking patio concrete which Hobert will say is ground movement, but the concrete is flaking. I’ve had a few concrete people out to look at it and everyone has said this was a bad pour. From the mix to quality of the mix to the quality of the sub Hobert uses. Good luck to those that use Hobert, you’re about to drop a lot of money on substandard materials and workmanship.
reviews.author: Corey

reviews.text: I would highly recommend Hobert pools for your pool building needs!!!! I did get other quotes from other pool companies or tried to at least. Other companies either did not show or just flaked. I made an appointment for a consultation and Chris Michaels showed up. He was on time and very nice and thoroughly explained the entire process. He was not pushy at all and he answered every question I had and I had a lot. He really went above and beyond!! I would highly recommend him!! As far as the pool building process it was amazing and very fast!!! They started September 4th and my project was completed Nov. 3!! Each phase of the project was explained in detail!!!! Every time they said contractors were coming they came at 7 am sharp and were done by noon!!! They never left a mess always cleaned up. The quality of all materials used is AMAZING!!! If I could give 10 stars I absolutely would!!! Hobert Pools and its employees are amazing and really go the extra mile to satisfy their customers. Huge thanks to everyone involved in my project!!! So so so happy!!!!!!
reviews.author: Shawndra Zullo

reviews.text:
We are satisfied with Hobert Pools.  All employees are professional.  They are great at communication throughout the whole process.
Every team that worked in our backyard were efficient, fast and professional, also.
We recommend this pool company.
reviews.author: Bren B

reviews.text:
We spent a lot of time talking with other pool companies and looking at designs.  We knew we had the right company (Hobert) when we had our first meeting with Chris.  We loved his design and we truly appreciated how responsive and informative Chris was with us.  We never felt pressured or uncomfortable when we were deciding on our pool.  Steve(project manager) was great to work with and also was very responsive and helpful throughout the process.  Angela was also great it getting everything scheduled and the project complete.   Building a pool is a long process especially when the weather doesn’t cooperate but we are beyond happy with the final product!  We would certainly recommend Hobert to anyone looking at building a pool!

***UPDATE*** as of 8/25/25

I wanted to update this review because I kind of feel like I have been punched in the gut.  Most of my original post still stands as far as working with everyone and the overall product.  I will just advise at all cost DO NOT get the stone coping around your pool.  At least not from whoever their supplier is.  The first time it was installed it began breaking apart within months and got so pitted I could pick up solid pieces.  They tried to remedy the situation by redoing all the coping with the same stone because they said there was a defect with that stone.  So after a gigantic mess, uneven stones, grout on my plaster, and just a huge mess they replaced the stone.  Well within 3 months the stones did the same thing and are actually worse.  The stones breaking apart have clogged my filters on a regular basis, made my water cloudy, and break apart on peoples feet (which is truly embarrassing for when we have guests).  I can wipe my hand across the top and take off an entire layer of stone.  It’s truly a mess.  One of the “new stones” already had a defect when they installed it and now has become a hole that goes from the top of the stone straight through to the skimmer.  I had to get stone filler to try and fix the problem before the entire stone fell apart. They sent someone out to look at it again and gave me a quote of 10k to redo it with a new material.  I was also told they don’t use that stone anymore because apparently this is a problem.  My neighbor has a pool built around the same time as ours but with a different company and they have none of the same issues with the stone.   Just be aware when spending 100k+ and getting this stone then being told it will cost another 10k to fix less than two years from build and less than a year from round two of stones.  I have tried sealing them no luck, tried rinsing them off with fresh water no luck, and I get my water tested quite often and never have issues with anything being out of wack.  The pictures are just a small example.  I can’t upload a video or I would show my finger just breaking the stones apart with zero pressure.
reviews.author: Jason Kimpel
